strongest_angle: Explore how the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias measured the largest known galaxy, IC 1101, revealing a main body spanning 520 kiloparsecs or nearly 1.7 million light-years across.

key_facts.fact: Researchers published a study on October 2, 2026, led by the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias, measuring the size of the largest known galaxy, IC 1101.
The galaxy IC 1101 has an estimated diameter of 520 kiloparsecs, or nearly 1.7 million light-years, as reported in a study submitted in July 2026.
Astronomers utilized ultra-deep images captured in 2022 by the Isaac Newton Telescope to analyze the physical extent and structure of IC 1101.
